pose: inner display, partially folded (book pose), landscape; vertical bar on trailing edge (x 996-1116, 10.7% of width); hinge at x=558

findings.title: Content centred on full display width, not the safe area
findings.problem: Everything is centred at x=558 (full-width centre) while the safe area ends at x=996 (centre x=498). With the bar present the whole player looks 60px off-centre to the right, and the centring is exactly what lands the Play button on the hinge.
findings.fix: Centre within the safe area: let the root VStack use the default safe-area layout and only put the background behind .ignoresSafeArea(). Do not compute centres from UIScreen.main.bounds / GeometryReader of the full window.

findings.title: Artwork crosses the hinge
findings.problem: The 340pt artwork is centred on the hinge; a third of it sits on the curved region and is distorted when folded.
findings.fix: Same ArrangementView(.split) fix as #1 - put the artwork in one pane so it never crosses the division.

findings.title: Track title and artist text cross the hinge
findings.problem: 'Midnight City' and 'M83' are centred on x=558, so the middle glyphs sit on the fold and are hard to read.
findings.fix: Move the labels into the artwork pane of the ArrangementView, or lay them out with reservedRegions(kind: .division) so text is displaced off the hinge.

findings.element: Custom bottom bar (Lyrics / Queue / Share / AirPlay / ...)
findings.title: Hand-built horizontal toolbar while the system bar is vertical
findings.problem: The system has already moved its own items (the three round buttons, Edit) to the vertical bar on the trailing edge, but this row of actions is a custom HStack pinned to the bottom. It stays horizontal, spans the hinge, and duplicates the bar's role.
findings.fix: Delete the custom row and declare the actions as toolbar items (.toolbar { ToolbarItemGroup(placement: .bottomBar) { ... } }) so the system relocates them to the vertical bar and overflows what does not fit.

findings.title: Text-only item in the vertical bar
findings.problem: 'Edit' is a text-only item. In the vertical bar it renders as a wide pill among round symbol buttons, wastes the narrow strip and truncates when localised.
findings.fix: Give it a symbol and a title (Label("Edit", systemImage: "pencil")) so it renders as a symbol in the vertical bar, or mark it .axisBehavior(.horizontalOnly) if the text must stay.

findings.title: Play button straddles the fold
findings.problem: The primary transport control is centred at x=558, exactly on the hinge line. When the device is partially folded the tap target sits on the curve and is split between the two halves.
findings.fix: Split the screen into two arrangement panes with ArrangementView(.split): artwork+metadata on one half, transport controls on the other. Alternatively read reservedRegions(kind: .division) and offset the control row to whichever half has room.

findings.title: Hand-rolled ellipsis / overflow
findings.problem: The custom row carries its own '...' item. Once the system bar overflows, this becomes a second 'more' menu (two ellipses on screen). Could not confirm from the image whether it is a menu or a button.
findings.fix: Remove it when the items move to .toolbar; use ToolbarOverflowMenu / additionalOverflowItems and visibilityPriority to control what overflows instead.
